name: Office Girls' Love, Shigodeki Joushi to no Dousei Seikatsu ~ Igai to Kawaii Kanojo no Sugao ~
original_name: オフィスガールズラブ、シゴデキ上司との同棲生活～意外と可愛い彼女の素顔～
source:
[i]"How many times are you going to make this exact same mistake? Can't you just do it right?"[/i]

My boss is giving me a tongue lashing. A well-deserved one too - that was stupid of me. 

So, yeah. It's frustrating, but I really should listen to her. No, really, I should.

[i]"... I haven't been counting, but... You're right. This has been coming up a lot. I thought I was being careful, but... Sorry."

"That's great. But if you could just do your job, we wouldn't have to be here. You don't want me to keep telling you off for the same things over and over again either, do you?"[/i]

Yeah. I keep making basic mistakes, and I'm not exactly a new hire anymore. Obviously she's going to get mad at me. 

Besides, they say that if the higher-ups are still bothering to lecture you, you're actually having it good. That they still have expectations of you. And, you know, if our positions were reversed? I'd also be giving her a stern talking-to. No doubt about it.

... It's just.

It's... just...!! It's. Just.

[b]It's just that I'm not actually the only one at fault here!!![/b] 

Okay... Back talk's usually off the table, but... Just this once. Let me off the hook for a bit. A tiny little bit.

[i]"... I'm sorry. As you are aware, I couldn't catch any sleep last night and that's obviously been affecting my performance. From now on I'd like us to try going to bed a bit earlier, if it's all the same to you?"

"..."

"..."

" 'It's important to keep work and life separate.' You got that?"

"Of course."[/i]

... Ah. I think I just felt my lips curl the slightest bit upwards.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/announce/=/product_id/RJ01726903.html]DLsite[/url].]
translation:
[i]“一模一样的错误你到底要犯多少次？就不能好好把事情做对吗？”[/i]

上司正在把我骂得狗血淋头。而且骂得一点儿都不冤——刚才那失误确实蠢透了。

所以嘛，虽然心里憋屈，但我确实该老老实实听训。不，真的，我活该挨训。

[i]“……具体几次我是没数过啦，不过……您说得对，最近确实老出这种岔子。我自以为已经很留神了，但……对不起。”

“知道就好。要是你平时能把本职工作做好，我们现在也不用站在这儿了。你也不想让我翻来覆去因为同一件事训你吧，嗯？”[/i]

是啊。我总在犯低级错误，而且我也早就不算新人了。她会对我发火简直再正常不过。

更何况人家都说，只要上级还愿意费口舌训你，就说明你的处境其实还不赖——说明她对你依然抱有期待。再说了，要是我们俩立场对调呢？我也绝对会板起脸把她狠狠训上一顿，毫无疑问。

……只不过。

只……不过……！！只不过啊。

[b]只不过这件事说到底根本不光是我一个人的错啊！！！[/b]

好吧……平时顶嘴肯定是绝对禁止的，但是……就这一次，稍微放我一马吧。就小小地回敬一下下。

[i]“……非常抱歉。如您所知，我昨晚一点儿觉都没睡成，显然严重影响了今天的工作状态。要是您不介意的话，从今天起，咱们能不能试着稍微早点上床睡觉呢？”

“……”

“……”

“‘公私分明可是很重要的。’听明白了吗？”

“那当然。”[/i]

……啊。我好像感觉到自己的嘴角，微微向上翘起了那么一点点。
